tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search across published THE COOP articles, supplier and media profiles and industry events. Returns one passage per record with canonical URLs, dates and a text-relevance band, not an answer-confidence score. Use get_article / get_supplier / get_event for the full record.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text of a published THE COOP article with sources, author, dates and any sponsorship disclosure.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Latest published THE COOP articles, optionally filtered by topic or format.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Browse THE COOP supplier and media profiles by name text, category and review status. Media records use the media category and carry no supplier rating.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: A supplier profile: facts with per-fact evidence status and source ids, sources with checked dates, editorial commentary, assessment and a list of missing information.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: iGaming industry events THE COOP tracks, with dates, venue and exhibitor counts.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Event details with organiser sources and exhibitor count. By default the large exhibitor list is omitted; use list_exhibitors to filter it, or include_exhibitors for the full list.

tools.name: list_exhibitors
tools.description: Filter and page an event's published exhibitor booths, with supplier profile links when available. Category and name filters are case-insensitive; booth assignments should be confirmed with the exhibitor.

tools.name: about_the_coop
tools.description: What THE COOP is, how its content is sourced and reviewed, how to cite it, and what this server logs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
